name: the empty-table guard goes, replaying the journal into a table that already has rows
the pruned skip goes, so a deleted job comes back on replay
the missed boundary goes, so every past-due job replays as pending and fires
the creation journal is dropped, so a database failure right after loses the schedule entirely
a claim replays as its raw status, restoring a launching job that only a later serve would reconcile
prune journals after deleting, so a failed journal no longer keeps the row
